prompt:
Draw ONE complete connected SX knight battle sprite in the instant of TAKEOFF, full body with full sword in transparent portrait 1024x1536. Image 1 is the exact approved design, image 2 is the accepted motion/color style. Do not detach or paste head/neck/weapon. Draw them together. Same compact helmet and face, deep cobalt blue, silver/ivory panels and restrained gold trim; do not increase gold or saturation.

Standing-body proportions MUST stay like the approved adult knight: long thighs and long shins, normal pelvis, full-length legs, not a squat/chibi body. Preserve knee/hip/ankle connections. The right knee lifts only modestly, the left leg pushes off almost straight with toe pointing down. Torso remains tall with both arms holding the sword ABOVE the head, slightly to the right so the face is fully readable. Cape trails behind-left.

The entire broad ivory/gold greatsword is VERY LONG (guard-to-tip approximately 75% of unbent head-to-sole body height), pointing perfectly straight UP vertically. Never shorten it into a dagger to fit. Gold pommel, black handle, round sunburst guard, raised gold central rib and tip form a single straight vertical axis. Parallel straight cutting edges, slight taper and pointed tip. No bent sword, no broken hilt, no duplicate handles. Full connected grip and fingers. Fit BOTH long legs and full tall sword by drawing the ENTIRE figure uniformly smaller, with 7% clear transparent margins around every outer edge. No background, no ground, no VFX, no text. High-detail same painted metallic finish.
